source: class Box { public int A = 1; }
class Box<T> { public T? V; public static int Count = 0; public static NeoAction Changed; }
interface IShape { int Sides(); }
interface IShape<T> { T Size(); }
class Sq : IShape, IShape<int> { public int Sides() => 4; public int Size() => 2; }
class Coin : IEquatable<Coin> {
public int V = 0;
public bool Equals(Coin? other) => other != null && other.V == V;
public override bool Equals(object? obj) => obj is Coin c && Equals(c);
public override int GetHashCode() => V;
public override string ToString() => "coin";
abstract class Keyed { public abstract override int GetHashCode(); }
class Ci : EqualityComparer<string> { public override bool Equals(string? x, string? y) => x == y; public override int GetHashCode(string obj) => 0; }
class Fold : EqualityComparer<string> { public override bool Equals(string? x, string? y) => x?.ToLower() == y?.ToLower(); public override int GetHashCode(string obj) => obj.Length; }
class ByLen : Comparer<string> { public override int Compare(string? x, string? y) => (x ?? "").Length - (y ?? "").Length; }
class Pt {
public int X = 0;
public static Pt operator +(Pt a, Pt b) { var p = new Pt(); p.X = a.X + b.X; return p; }
public static Pt operator <<(Pt a, Pt b) => a;
interface IV<out T> { string Name() => "v"; }
class Kv : IV<string> { }
class InitOnly { public int A { get; init; } = 0; }
class Auto { public int W { get; protected set; } = 1; }
class Holder { public CultureInfo Culture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture; public IFormatProvider? Provider = null; public EqualityComparer<string>? Cmp = null; }
class Parsed {
public int V = 0;
public static bool TryParse(string s, @maybeNullWhen(false) out Parsed result) { if (s == "ok") { result = new Parsed(); result.V = 1; return true; } result = default; return false; }
public static bool TryFind(string s, @notNullWhen(true) out Parsed? result) { result = s == "ok" ? new Parsed() : null; return result != null; }
public static bool TryFirst<T>(List<T> items, @maybeNullWhen(false) out T result) { if (items.Count > 0) { result = items[0]; return true; } result = default; return false; }
class Probe {
public static Fold FoldComparer = new Fold();
public static ByLen LengthComparer = new ByLen();
public static bool TryIt(out int v) { v = 1; return true; }
public static int OutArgument() { if (TryIt(out var v)) return v; return -1; }
public static int ArityPair() { var b = new Box(); var g = new Box<string>(); g.V = "seven"; return b.A * 10 + (g.V ?? "").Length; }
public static int InterfaceArityPair() { IShape s = new Sq(); IShape<int> t = new Sq(); return s.Sides() * 10 + t.Size(); }
public static int GenericStaticPerConstruction() { Box<int>.Count = 3; Box<string>.Count = 5; return Box<int>.Count * 10 + Box<string>.Count; }
public static string OverrideToString() { object o = new Coin(); return o.ToString(); }
public static bool OverrideEquals() { var a = new Coin(); a.V = 2; var b = new Coin(); b.V = 2; object o = a; return o.Equals(b); }
public static int OverrideGetHashCode() { var c = new Coin(); c.V = 9; object o = c; return o.GetHashCode(); }
public static int OperatorForward() { var a = new Pt(); a.X = 1; var b = new Pt(); b.X = 2; return (a + b).X; }
public static bool ComparerSlot() { var h = new Holder(); h.Cmp = new Ci(); return h.Cmp.Equals("a", "a") && h.Cmp.GetHashCode("x") == 0; }
public static string DefaultInterfaceMember() { IV<string> v = new Kv(); return v.Name(); }
public static bool NonGenericComparerEquals() { IEqualityComparer c = FoldComparer; return c.Equals("lower", "LOWER"); }
public static int NonGenericComparerGetHashCode() { IEqualityComparer c = FoldComparer; return c.GetHashCode("abc"); }
public static int NonGenericComparerCompare() { IComparer c = LengthComparer; return c.Compare("aa", "b"); }
public static bool MaybeNullOutFails() { return !Parsed.TryParse("bad", out var p) && p == null; }
public static int MaybeNullOutSucceeds() { if (Parsed.TryParse("ok", out var p)) return p.V; return -1; }
public static bool NotNullOutFails() { return !Parsed.TryFind("bad", out var p) && p == null; }
public static bool GenericMaybeNullOutFails() { return !Parsed.TryFirst(new List<string>(), out var s) && s == null; }
